ground_truth.title: Air Purifiers
ground_truth.main_content:
Clorox air purifiers are designed with a focus on effective filtration, ease of use, and trusted brand performance. Utilizing True HEPA filtration to capture up to 99.97% of airborne particles such as dust, pollen, mold spores, and smoke, as well as tested to capture up to 99.9% of airborne viruses and bacteria.

Clorox's 360-degree air intake design, helps pull in air from all directions for more filtration. Many models also include a built in air quality sensor with auto mode, adjusting fan speed based on real time air conditions for consistent performance without manual effort. A color coded air quality display and filter replacement indicator make maintenance simple and intuitive, even for first time users.

Medium Room Turbo Air Purifier
$89.99

The Clorox Medium Room Turbo Air Purifier captures 99.97% of allergens and particulates and reduces viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier. The 3 stage 360 degree filter captures particulates in 3 filter layers and has a True HEPA filter.

Medium Room Turbo+ True HEPA Air Purifier
$143.99

The Medium Room Turbo+ True HEPA Air Purifier captures 99.97% of allergens and particulates and 99.9% of viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier.

Ultra Air Purifier with UV-C Light
$299.99

The Ultra Air Purifier with UV-C Light provides exceptional filtration beyond HEPA standards in extra-large living spaces. It captures 99.99% of airborne germs and the innovative design delivers 4 stage 360 degree purification.

Large Room True HEPA Air Purifier
$179.99

The Clorox Large Room Air Purifier captures 99.97% of allergens and particulates and 99.9% of viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier. The 3 stage 360 degree filter captures particulates in 3 filter layers and includes a True HEPA filter.

Medium Room True HEPA Air Purifier
$139.99

The Medium Room Air Purifier captures 99.97% of allergens and particulates and reduces viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier. The 3 stage 360 degree filter captures particulates in 3 filter layers and includes a True HEPA filter.

Tabletop True HEPA Air Purifier
$74.99

The Clorox Tabletop Air Purifier captures 99.97% of particulates as small as 0.3 microns and reduces viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier. The 2 stage 360 degree filter captures particulates in a pre-filter and True HEPA filter.

Smart Tabletop True HEPA Air Purifier
$69.99

Control the Clorox Smart Tabletop Air Purifier with voice commands via an Alexa smart speaker or the Alexa app on your phone. It captures 99.97% of allergens and particulates and 99.9% of viruses and bacteria so you can breathe easier.
